label: original-phase conjunction: first token z/r/l + early 0 + specific prev/current tokens
explanation: Very sparse (about 0.006% of steps). Fires only in the original phase at t>=3 (mostly t=3-4); never at the delimiter or during copy. Behaves like a soft AND over several weak cues rather than one token: first token z or r (also l), a digit 0 two steps back (usually at position 1), previous token n/a/j/u, current token y/z/3/d/t, and an early position. Typical top example: r 0 a [3], z 0 j a [y]. When all five cues hold, precision is about 0.84 (dev) but that covers only ~16% of mass; requiring 4 of 5 covers ~65% of mass at about 7% precision. Stronger activations go with more cues being satisfied. No single crisp predicate gets above F1 ~0.25.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=z (+4.56), orig1=0 (+3.22), orig2=a (+3.03), orig0=r (+3.02), orig2=0 (+2.36), orig0=l (+2.13). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-3.49), prev3_tok=- (-3.41), prev3_tok=z (-1.21).
